why: I47 (tests_m4/test_i47_factory.py rule T6, preregistered with I47 in spec/M4/predictions.json) requires that no holon/ file outside the record-pinned residue names a target. holon/__main__.py's replay checkout flag, allowlisted here for the word 'morph', is then read from targets/<dev>/target.json (checkout.flag), so the file holds no target identifier and its ALLOWLIST entry is removed. The flag's spelling on the command line is unchanged; every other entry and the identifier set are unchanged.
